How to crack a ₹25 LPA Data Engineer job?
If you're targeting ₹25 LPA, don't focus on learning every tool in the market.
Focus on becoming someone who can solve real data engineering problems.
Here’s what you need:
1️⃣ SQL
Master joins, CTEs, window functions, analytical queries, data cleaning, and query optimization.
Don't just solve SQL questions. Understand why your solution works and how to make it efficient.
2️⃣ Python
Learn Python specifically for data engineering.
Focus on APIs, file processing, automation, error handling, logging, and writing reusable code.
3️⃣ Cloud
Pick one cloud platform and go deep.
For AWS, understand S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, IAM, Step Functions, and EventBridge — and more importantly, how they work together.
4️⃣ Data Modeling
Understand grain, fact tables, dimensions, SCDs, star schema, and incremental loading.
A good data engineer understands the business problem before building the pipeline.
5️⃣ Build REAL projects
Don't build:
CSV → Python → Database
Build something closer to production:
API → S3 → Glue/PySpark → Snowflake/Redshift → dbt → BI
Add incremental loads, data quality checks, logging, retries, monitoring, and CI/CD.
6️⃣ Learn System Design
Be prepared to design scalable pipelines and explain:
Architecture
Performance
Cost
Reliability
Security
Trade-offs
7️⃣ Prepare your project stories
Interviewers want to know what YOU did.
Be ready to explain:
A production issue you solved
How you improved performance
How you handled failures
How you improved data quality
A migration you worked on
Why you chose a particular architecture
8️⃣ Fix your resume
Don't write:
"Worked on AWS Glue and Snowflake."
Show what you built, what problem you solved, and the impact.
9️⃣ Don't wait to know everything
You don't need 15 certifications and 30 tools.
Strong fundamentals + real projects + production experience + good interview preparation can take you much further.
₹25 LPA isn't about memorizing 500 interview questions.
It's about being able to demonstrate that you can handle the responsibilities of the role.
